title: No Travel Origin, Uncontrollable (delay code 01, upline weather), APPR
description:
A single-leg flight is delayed by more than 3 hours because of delay code 01 (late positioning due to upline weather, uncontrollable). The customer decides not to travel and stays at the origin. Checks that No Travel Origin + an uncontrollable arrival delay code returns Not Eligible for compensation under APPR, with a full ticket refund entitlement.

Prerequisites:
PNR TC041: one adult passenger, one AC domestic leg YUL?YYZ, AC 460, May 28, 2026. Scheduled 10:00 ? 12:00. Actual departure 14:20 (260 min late). Actual arrival 16:25 (265 min late). No cancellation code. First arrival delay code 01 (UW). First departure delay code 01 (UW). Passenger not boarded and coupon not flown. Customer stayed at YUL. No Travel status: Origin. No rebooking accepted.
